decisions.reason: As a mature German wood-products firm, it has much stronger absorptive capacity in wooden craftsmanship than in electronics, so this product is less aligned with existing knowledge and harder to improve from early market feedback.

A wooden nativity stable fits the firm's established materials, production skills and seasonal decorative know-how very closely, making it easy to interpret demand and refine the product with existing capabilities.

A modern incense smoker figurine is still closely related to the firm's wooden decorative core, and the firm is likely able to learn from initial sales and adjust design or finish without needing unfamiliar knowledge.
